Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Weather / season: autumn — falling leaves and warm low light outside.
Time of day: early morning — low clean light, long soft shadows.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.

POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right fingertips rest lightly on her cheek.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: heavy-lidded eyes, lips slightly parted and relaxed, brow smooth.
